name: piece-select
prompt: A soft fingertip tap on a small glazed ceramic mosaic tile, short bright click with a faint glassy ring.

name: piece-pickup
prompt: A small ceramic tile being lifted off a wooden tray, quick gentle scrape and lift with a light clink.

name: piece-place
prompt: A ceramic mosaic tile set down onto a wooden board, soft thud followed by a short satisfying clink.

name: piece-snap
prompt: Two magnetic puzzle pieces snapping together, crisp clean snap with a tight plastic-and-ceramic click.

name: piece-rotate
prompt: A small tile spun a quarter turn on a felt surface, short airy whoosh with a faint friction swish.

name: invalid-move
prompt: A wooden block knocked gently against a table edge, dull muted double thud signaling refusal.

name: hint-reveal
prompt: A tiny brass bell shimmer with a soft rising glissando, like light sparkling across glass tiles.

name: undo-move
prompt: A tile sliding backward across a wooden board, brief reverse whoosh ending in a soft settling clink.

name: round-complete
prompt: A warm celebratory chime arpeggio on a small glockenspiel, four bright ascending notes with gentle reverb.

name: round-fail
prompt: A soft descending marimba phrase of three mellow wooden notes, quiet and disappointed, no harshness.

name: timer-tick
prompt: A single precise mechanical clock tick, short dry metallic click from a small wind-up timer.

name: ui-click
prompt: A subtle modern interface button click, very short soft plastic tap with a clean muted attack.
